title: Use Seedance 2.5 white-model control by importing a 3D model or animation as…
content: Use Seedance 2.5 white-model control by importing a 3D model or animation as the motion/scene base, then prompt Seedance to re-skin the blank figure into your desired character.
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 white-model control by importing a 3D model or animation as the motion/scene base, then prompt Seedance to re-skin the blank figure into your desired character.

es.content: Usa el control del modelo blanco de Seedance 2.5 importando un modelo 3D o una animación como base de movimiento/escena, y luego indica a Seedance que retexturice la figura en blanco para convertirla en el personaje que deseas.

fr.content: Utilisez le contrôle du modèle blanc Seedance 2.5 en important un modèle 3D ou une animation comme base de mouvement/scène, puis demandez à Seedance de re-skin la figure vierge en votre personnage souhaité.

ja.content: 3Dモデルやアニメーションをモーション／シーンのベースとしてインポートし、Seedance 2.5のwhite-model controlを使って、空のフィギュアを希望するキャラクターに再スキンします。

ko.content: 3D 모델이나 애니메이션을 motion/scene 기반으로 가져와 Seedance 2.5 white-model control을 사용한 다음, Seedance에 빈 피겨를 원하는 캐릭터로 다시 스킨하도록 프롬프트를 입력하세요.

pt.content: Use o controle do modelo branco do Seedance 2.5 importando um modelo 3D ou uma animação como base de movimento/cena, e então peça ao Seedance para reestilizar a figura em branco no personagem desejado.

zh.content: 通过导入 3D 模型或动画作为动作/场景基础，使用 Seedance 2.5 white-model control，然后提示 Seedance 将空白角色重新换皮为你想要的角色。
